description: This Java source file defines the ReceiptsList class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying a list of receipts retrieved from a remote server. It manages a RecyclerView to show receipts, loads data via network requests, and handles cases where no receipts are available.

classes.name: ReceiptsList
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that displays a list of receipts fetched from a server. It manages the RecyclerView to display receipt data, loads data asynchronously, and handles empty states.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes the RecyclerView, sets layout manager and item decoration, clears the current receipt list, and initiates data loading.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Fetches receipt data from a remote server using Volley. Parses JSON response to populate the receipt list and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Replaces the RecyclerView with a TextView indicating that no receipts are uploaded when there is no data.
